sloka: अश्वं मुक्तं गजो दृष्ट्वा क्वचिद्भीतो ऽपसर्पति।भीतो भीतं गजं दृष्ट्वा क्वचिदश्वो निवर्तते ।। ६.७५.२७ ।।
transliteration: aśvaṁ muktaṁ gajo dṛṣṭvā kvacidbhīto 'pasarpati।bhīto bhītaṁ gajaṁ dṛṣṭvā kvacidaśvo nivartate ।। 6.75.27 ।।

translations.english: While the tops of dwellings were burning, flames were blazing, and Lanka seemed adorned with Kimsuka blossoms.
